evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 洞天深处
evidence.excerpt_zh: 洞天深處在如意館西稍南前宇乃諸皇子所居為四所東西二街南北一街前為福園門四所之西為諸皇子肄業之所前有前垂天貺中為中天景物東宇為斯文在兹後為後天不老（圓明園册）臣等謹按洞天深處四十景之一額為皇上御書前垂天貺中天景物後天不老及如意館諸額皆世宗御書斯文在兹額恭懸至聖先師神龕上聫曰道統集成歸至徳聖功養正仰微言皆御書
evidence.summary: West and a little south of 如意館, near the 福園門: four courts where the imperial princes lived, with streets between; west of them the princes' school with 前垂天貺, 中天景物, 斯文在兹 (shrine to Confucius) and 後天不老.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01) with no label, 5x1 cells: a building stood here, its name unknown.
